floorPlans.introduction: Open the published apartment plans and both levels of the four-bedroom duplex. Some spreads show two layouts together.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Mamsha Palm floor plan
floorPlans.note: The sheets label room dimensions and some balcony areas. Confirm the total area and signed drawing for the residence. Building floorplates are in the original brochure.

review.images: Corporate architecture, rooftop pool and tea room originals and distinct interior and arrival images embedded in Aldar’s official brochure. The waterfront aerial is scoped to context.
review.location: The official brochure’s physical page 21 identifies the tower and coastline. Times are from Property Finder’s Mamsha Palm page. Bayut separately reports seven minutes to the Louvre; retained the Property Finder set as approximate, without merging estimates. No precise entrance pin was verified.
review.floorPlans: The official 42-page brochure includes nine unit layouts across physical pages 29–34. Each full spread is preserved. Pages 35–39 are building floorplates and remain in the source PDF. No exact whole-home area is printed on the plan sheets.

unavailable: Confirmed entrance coordinates and plan-specific total areas.
